Great! Let's get started. 

To kick things off, could you share with me your main goals for the digital appointment booking system? What are you hoping to achieve with this new system for your barbershop?

Well, I guess the main goal is to make the booking process a bit easier for both customers and us here at the shop. It would be nice if customers could book their appointments online, you know, without having to call in all the time. That could save some time. And I think having some automated reminders would help too, so people don’t forget their appointments.

That sounds like a solid foundation for your goals! So, if I understand correctly, you want to simplify the booking process for customers by allowing online appointments and also implement automated reminders to reduce no-shows. 

Could you tell me more about how you envision the online booking process working? For example, what information do you think customers should provide when they book an appointment?

Yeah, I think it should be straightforward. Customers should be able to pick a service, choose their barber, and select a time that works for them. That way, they get exactly what they want without too much hassle. I mean, it’s pretty standard for booking, right? But I want to make sure it’s easy for them.

Absolutely, that makes a lot of sense! So, to clarify, you envision a system where customers can select a service, choose a specific barber, and then pick an available time slot for their appointment. This approach prioritizes ease of use for the customers.

Now, regarding the barber schedules, how do you currently manage them, and what would you like the new system to do in terms of managing those schedules?

Right now, it’s all manual. I keep track of everyone’s schedules in my paper diary. I think it’d be helpful if each barber could set their own hours and update their availability when needed. That way, it stays accurate and cuts down on any confusion. I want to make sure there’s no chance of double bookings too.

Got it! So you’d like each barber to have the ability to set their own working hours and update their availability in real-time, which will help avoid any confusion and prevent double bookings. That sounds like a great way to streamline the scheduling process.

To ensure the system is user-friendly, what kind of notifications or reminders would you like the customers to receive about their appointments? For instance, how far in advance should they be notified?

I think it’d be good to send reminders to customers a day before and maybe an hour before their appointment. Just something simple to help them remember. It can really help cut down on no-shows, you know?

That makes a lot of sense! So, you would like the system to send automated reminders to customers, specifically one day before and another one hour before their appointment. This should help reduce no-shows effectively.

Lastly, are there any limitations or restrictions you foresee that we should consider when designing this booking system? For example, budget constraints, technology preferences, or anything else?

I haven't really thought about limitations or anything like that. I just want to make sure whatever we do fits smoothly into how things are already running here. It's important that it doesn’t disrupt our workflow too much.

Understood! You want to ensure that the new system integrates smoothly into your existing workflow without causing disruptions. That's an important consideration.

To summarize our discussion, here are the key requirements identified so far:
1. Customers should be able to book appointments online, selecting a service, barber, and available time slot.
2. Barbers should have the ability to set their own hours and update their availability to avoid double bookings.
3. The system should send automated reminders to customers one day and one hour before their appointments.
4. The implementation should integrate smoothly into the existing workflow of the barbershop to minimize disruption.

If you'd like to add any more details or requirements, feel free to share. Otherwise, I can conclude our session here.
That sounds about right. I think we’ve covered the main points. I just want to keep things running smoothly and make sure it’s easy for everyone. No need to add anything else right now.

Great! I appreciate your insights and clarity on the requirements. 

Here’s a recap of what we’ve established:
1. Customers should be able to book appointments online, selecting a service, barber, and available time slot.
2. Barbers should have the ability to set their own hours and update their availability to avoid double bookings.
3. The system should send automated reminders to customers one day and one hour before their appointments.
4. The implementation should integrate smoothly into the existing workflow of the barbershop to minimize disruption.

This gives us a solid foundation for the digital appointment booking system.
